freshRecords.title: 113th Wing recognized for air defense, combat performance
freshRecords.summary: ARLINGTON, Virginia – At first glance, the District of Columbia Air National Guard's alert facility looks more like a family room than the home of one of the nation's most critical homeland defense missions. freshRecords.title: Alaska’s Frontier Grit Takes the Win at First-Ever NGAUS State Pin Competition
freshRecords.summary: INDIANAPOLIS — A little Alaska creativity, a little Hoosier horsepower and a bear behind the wheel proved to be a winning combination at the National Guard Association of the United States’ 148th General Conference and Exhibition in Indianapolis. Lt. Col. Yutashea Zirkle, director of staff for the 168th Wing, Alaska Air National Guard, designed Alaska’s “Frontier Grit, Indy Speed” pin, which won Best State Pin during the first-ever National Guard Association of Indiana state pin competition at this year’s conference.

freshRecords.title: From engineer to storyteller: Barrieau retires after 25 years
freshRecords.summary: U.S. Army Master Sgt. Caleb P. Barrieau, regional chief of public affairs for the Army & Air Force Exchange Service’s Europe, Southwest Asia and Africa region, retires after 25 years of military service during a ceremony hosted by the 21st Theater Sustainment Command at Panzer Field on Panzer Kaserne in Kaiserslautern, Germany, Sept. 3, 2026. Barrieau began his career as an engineer in the Maine Army National Guard before transitioning to active duty, where he served as an Army broadcast journalist and public affairs noncommissioned officer. The ceremony also recognized his wife, Monica, and their children, Josephine, Emilia and Cooper, for their support and sacrifices throughout his career.

freshRecords.title: U.S.-based F-35B squadron deploys to Japan for Unit Deployment Program
freshRecords.summary: MARINE CORPS AIR STATION IWAKUNI, Japan – The U.S. Marine Corps deployed Marine Fighter Attack Squadron (VMFA) 533, also known as the “Hawks,” an F-35B Lightning II squadron based at Marine Corps Air Station Beaufort, South Carolina to MCAS Iwakuni, Japan, under the Marine Corps’ Unit Deployment Program (UDP) on Sept. 5, 2026. VMFA-533 joins Marine Aircraft Group (MAG) 12, 1st Marine Aircraft Wing, and will conduct aviation operations and maintain combat readiness throughout the Indo-Pacific region. VMFA-533 will integrate as the new UDP squadron, replacing the current UDP squadron, VMFA-232.

freshRecords.title: Water purification sustains Super Garuda Shield 26
freshRecords.summary: U.S. service members purified 36,000 gallons of water daily from the Komering River during Super Garuda Shield 26, providing safe water for personnel across the training area. trace.title: U.S. Soldiers demonstrate resiliency during Exercise Masurian Patrol in Poland
trace.summary: A U.S. Army eight-man team assigned to Charlie Company, 2nd Battalion, 37th Armored Regiment competed in a British Patrol Competition from Sept. 1 to 3.. Teams gathered to begin the two-day Exercise Masurian Patrol at the Bemowo Piskie Training Area in Poland. The exercise was named for the Masurian region, where the training area is located. The British-run competition is based on Exercise Cambrian Patrol, which normally takes place in the rugged Cambrian Mountains and swampland of mid-Wales.
